abstract: This new portable magnetic recording channel, designed primarily for 17 1/2mm film provides high-quality operation and all of the needed facilities for production recording. By operating at 45 fpm a considerable economy in film cost is realized and the size and weight of the recorder are reduced. The recorder is also adaptable for 16mm or 35mm film. A new amplifier system utilizing miniature tubes and small components is provided as part of the equipment.
